biotools.summary: GenoPred is a Snakemake pipeline for polygenic scoring that implements leading methodologies within an easy-to-use, reference-standardized, and reproducible workflow. It facilitates the generation of interpretable polygenic scores and improves the transferability of results to external datasets.
